name: Ley de Benford
description: Prueba las distribuciones de gradiente de pixeles contra la Ley de Benford.
mechanism: Analiza first significant digits in DCT coeficientes of 8x8 image blocks. Natural images follow Benfords Law, while generado por IA images deviate from this estadístico property.
parameters: Tamaño de bloque: 8x8, DCT coeficientes: AC terms, Test: chi2 goodness-of-fit
accuracy: Moderada - 65-75%, best as complementary estadístico test
source: Fu et al. (2007) Generalized Benfords Law for JPEG Coefficients, IEEE TIFS
useCase: Statistical validation of image naturalness through digit distribución

references.title: Fu, D. et al. (2007). Generalized Benford's Law for JPEG Coefficients. IEEE TIFS.
Perez-Gonzalez, F. et al. (2007). Benford's Law in Image Forensics. IEEE ICIP.

strengths:
• Based on well-established mathematical law
• Fast computation with minimal overhead
• Independent of image content type
• Effective complementary estadístico test
limitations:
• Lower standalone precisión (65-75%)
• compresión JPEG can mask deviations
• Requires sufficient image complexity
• Not effective for very small images
